experiments.question: Can a deterministic, fully typed, fail-closed engine build a causal MA-density candidate dataset with matched random controls, such that identical inputs reproduce identical bars, features, candidates and hashes?
experiments.result: P1 gate passed; P2 never started. The repository reaches ROADMAP P1 complete (canonical OKX ingestion, idempotent incremental updates, Parquet snapshots with manifests, gap/duplicate/stale/unclosed rejection, causal MA-density candidates, density diagnostics, matched random controls) with every P2 box unchecked, reports/generated/ empty, and no LightGBM, label or walk-forward code on any branch including the remotes. Superseded by this consolidation, which ports the engineering (typed contracts, fail-closed config, artifact lineage, matched-control design, closed-bar continuity checks) into fable-trading rather than continuing the engine.
